description: List the watches on an endpoint with their facts: enabled state, match count, last match time, and last predicate error, since a broken watch shows its error here instead of failing captures. Use it after register_watch, or when the user asks what is being watched or whether anything matched. On a guest credential each predicate reads null, so the host's matching logic stays private; it still works for a joined guest as the stream roster, since watch labels are the participant names.

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to use the claimed or only endpoint.

name: list_watches
title: List watches
